grid_fit_bootstrap.why: Q4 compares bootstrap SEs to the formula; at B = 500 the percentile width carries ~7 % noise of its own

criteria.question: Does alpha_hat hold on a third day?
criteria.prediction: plan calibration, every error x alpha 'all' (preregister.py); the execution-calibration prediction is secondary
criteria.view: P(solution) at lambda = 1; a record's drift copy pooled with it (one distinct circuit per record)
criteria.verdict_rule: per set: 'held' iff every record's |P_hw - P_pred| <= threshold_abs; RMS and max reported

sentences.fitted.held: On a third day, alpha_hat predicted every circuit it was fitted to within {threshold_abs} at lambda = 1 (RMS {rms:.3f}, largest {max_abs:.3f}).
sentences.fitted.not held: On a third day, alpha_hat missed {n_out} of the {n} circuits it was fitted to by more than {threshold_abs} at lambda = 1 (RMS {rms:.3f}, largest {max_abs:.3f}).
sentences.out_of_sample.held: On circuits it was not fitted to, from another day's transpilation, alpha_hat held within {threshold_abs} (RMS {rms:.3f}, largest {max_abs:.3f}).
sentences.out_of_sample.not held: On circuits it was not fitted to, alpha_hat missed {n_out} of {n} by more than {threshold_abs} (RMS {rms:.3f}, largest {max_abs:.3f}).

criteria.question: All errors x alpha_all, or CZ errors x alpha_2q?
criteria.prediction: plan calibration, each model at its own alpha
criteria.view: lambda = 1 RMS over the same records (drift copies pooled)

fitted.what: the same circuits on day 1 (in-sample): each model's lambda = 1 deviation from the job-1 alpha cache of its error class, at its alpha

out_of_sample.what: the same circuits on day 2, predicted before that job

criteria.verdict_rule: per set: 'not decidable by design' if the predicted RMS of (P_all - P_2q) < decidable_min_predicted_rms_difference; else '<model> better' iff its RMS is lower by >= margin; else 'indistinguishable'

sentences.all better: Scaling every error fits the third day better than scaling the CZ errors alone (RMS {rms_all:.3f} vs {rms_2q:.3f}).
sentences.2q better: Scaling the CZ errors alone fits the third day better than scaling every error (RMS {rms_2q:.3f} vs {rms_all:.3f}).
sentences.indistinguishable: The third day does not separate the two models (RMS {rms_all:.3f} vs {rms_2q:.3f}, margin {margin}).
sentences.not decidable by design: The two models predict these circuits too alike to be told apart (predicted RMS difference {predicted_rms_difference:.3f}).

criteria.question: Does the grid alone decide?
criteria.view: status of each named grid fitted separately on the same counts (lambda = 1 shared)
criteria.note: The odd half is close to certain (lambda = 5 is expected at random); the question is decided by the gentle fit on the day-1 circuit.
criteria.verdict_rule: 'confirmed' iff odd status in odd_statuses and gentle status == gentle_status; else 'not confirmed'

sentences.confirmed: On the same circuit, layout, shots and job, the odd grid could not resolve the extrapolation ({odd_status}) and the gentle grid did: the grid alone decided.
sentences.not confirmed: On the same circuit and job the odd grid gave '{odd_status}' and the gentle grid '{gentle_status}': the grid alone did not decide as predicted.

criteria.question: Does the error formula predict hardware?
criteria.view: SE_boot = (hi - lo) / 3.92 of the UNCLIPPED bootstrap interval (clipping at 1 shrinks the interval)

Q4a.what: the formula itself: exp_fixed_se at the observed P(lambda) vs the bootstrap
Q4a.eligibility: predicted relative SE (pre-registered) <= eligible_max_predicted_relative_se and observed status 'resolved'
Q4a.verdict_rule: 'held' iff every eligible fit's ratio is inside window; 'not tested' if no fit is eligible

Q4b.what: the prospective prediction: SE_boot / SE_pred(alpha_all), with the SE_pred band at the alpha_r quantiles (alpha_r_band)
Q4b.reason_not_tested: SE_pred moves -25 %/+35 % for a 15 % error in c, the size of the between-circuit alpha_r scatter

Q4c.what: the grid rule on P-n2-M1-11_L1: SE_boot(gentle) / SE_boot(rule) vs the predicted SE_pred(gentle) / SE_pred(rule)

sentences.Q4a.held: Where its predicted relative error was at most {eligible_max_predicted_relative_se}, the propagated error matched the bootstrap on every resolved hardware fit (ratios {ratios}).
sentences.Q4a.not held: Where its predicted relative error was at most {eligible_max_predicted_relative_se}, the propagated error missed the bootstrap on {n_out} of {n} resolved hardware fits (ratios {ratios}).
sentences.Q4a.not tested: No resolved fit had a predicted relative error of at most {eligible_max_predicted_relative_se}; the formula was not tested.
sentences.Q4c.held: The grid rule's predicted gain held: the gentle grid's error was {observed:.2f} times the rule grid's, against {predicted:.2f} predicted.
sentences.Q4c.not held: The grid rule's predicted gain did not hold: the gentle grid's error was {observed:.2f} times the rule grid's, against {predicted:.2f} predicted.
sentences.Q4c.not tested: The P-n2 grid comparison was not tested: {reason}.

criteria.question: Predicted ZNE status
criteria.view: every record x named grid, fitted separately
criteria.prediction: P(status) by a parametric bootstrap of binomial counts at the alpha_all prediction and the planned shots
criteria.verdict_rule: reported: how many fits got the pre-registered status (the gate at the expected values), against the number expected if the predictions are right (the sum of each pre-registered status's bootstrap probability)

sentences.reported: The pre-registered status matched on {matches} of {n} fits; the predictions expected {expected:.1f}.

criteria.question: Is alpha_r a property of the circuit?
criteria.data: per record, alpha_r fitted to its lambda = 1 PUB with its drift copy pooled, on the alpha grid of the day's execution calibration (step 4's method); bootstrap SE (alpha_r_se)
criteria.exclusion: step 4's rule on either day: over-rotated (r > r_opt), alpha_r at the grid edge, non-monotone model curve, at random (lambda = 1 less than 2 sigma above P_u)
criteria.caveat: alpha_r intervals hold shot noise only; calibration-measurement noise is not in them, so the test leans toward 'not reproducible'
criteria.verdict_rule: 'reproducible per circuit' iff chi2/dof of the differences, after removing one weighted-mean shift per reference day (dof = n - number of reference days), <= max_chi2_red_differences AND the day-3 between-circuit chi2/dof about its weighted mean > min_chi2_red_between_day3; 'not reproducible' if the first fails; 'no scatter to reproduce' if only the second fails; Spearman reported, not tested

sentences.reproducible per circuit: A circuit's alpha is a property of the circuit: on a third day it reproduced circuit by circuit (chi2/dof {chi2_red_differences:.2f} after a common shift of {shifts}), while circuits still differed from one another (chi2/dof {chi2_red_between:.2f}).
sentences.not reproducible: A circuit's alpha did not reproduce on a third day (chi2/dof {chi2_red_differences:.2f} after a common shift of {shifts}): the scatter between circuits is not a fixed property of each circuit.
sentences.no scatter to reproduce: On the third day the circuits no longer differed beyond shot noise (chi2/dof {chi2_red_between:.2f}), so there was no per-circuit scatter to reproduce.
sentences.not tested: Not tested: {n} circuits remained after the exclusions, too few for the differences and the scatter.

criteria.question: P-n3-M2-17: layout or day?
criteria.view: P(solution) at lambda = 1, drift copy pooled

categories.fine: not random and P_hw >= P_pred - fine_threshold
categories.degraded: not random and P_hw < P_pred - fine_threshold

criteria.decidability: per layout: P_pred - P_u >= fine_threshold + random_k_sigma * sigma(P_pred); else that layout's category is 'calibration predicts it'

map.L2=random,L1=fine: a persistent defect of the day-2 layout that the calibration does not show
map.L2=random,L1=random: not a layout effect: both layouts were at random on the third day; open
map.L2=fine,L1=random: the defect moved to the day-1 layout; open
map.L2=degraded,L1=fine: a persistent, partial defect of the day-2 layout: still below its calibration, no longer at random
map.L2=degraded,L1=degraded: both layouts below the prediction: this instance degraded on the third day, on either layout; open
map.L2=degraded,L1=random: the day-1 layout at random and the day-2 layout degraded; open
map.L2=random,L1=degraded: the day-2 layout still at random and the day-1 layout degraded; mostly a layout defect, open
map.L2=fine,L1=degraded: the day-2 layout recovered and the day-1 layout degraded: a transient that moved; open

criteria.question: Does gentle-grid ZNE reach n = 4?
criteria.verdict_rule: 'reaches' iff the gentle fit is resolved; 'does not reach' otherwise (the lambda = 1 value is reported); 'not tested' if the record's folds were trimmed. Whether the interval contains the ideal is reported, not tested

sentences.reaches: The gentle grid resolves the extrapolation at n = 4, r = 1: {value:.3f} [{lo:.3f}, {hi:.3f}] against an ideal of {p_ideal:.3f}.
sentences.does not reach: At n = 4, r = 1 the gentle grid did not resolve the extrapolation ({status}); the unmitigated value is {p1:.3f}.
sentences.not tested: Not tested: the folds of {record} were trimmed.

criteria.question: Does the P-n4-M1-10_r2 residual reproduce?
criteria.view: lambda = 1 residual P_hw - P_pred(alpha 'all'), day 3 (plan calibration) beside day 1 (execution calibration, in-sample)

sentences.reported: The day-1 residual of P-n4-M1-10_r2 at lambda = 1 was {day1:+.3f} (z {day1_z:+.1f}); on the third day it was {day3:+.3f} (z {day3_z:+.1f}).

reported_untested.what: day-3 layer fidelity: EPLG and EPLG / median CZ from the execution calibration's raw_properties.general, beside days 1-2 (alpha_robustness.json layered.days)

excluded_because: day-2 out-of-sample failure (at random on every circuit)
